lines.en: label kaorisummer2noongen:
scene kaorisummer2noongen
I give Kaori a call to find out that she has a rare afternoon off, so the two of us make plans to go out to eat at what she describes as “her new favorite restaurant.”
lines.zh: 我给 Kaori 打了个电话，发现她难得下午有空，于是我们俩约好去她口中的“她新最喜欢的餐厅”吃饭。

lines.en: As soon as she sends me the address and I realize where I am going, I’m overcome with an intense feeling of pride that is hard to put into words.
lines.zh: 她一把地址发过来、我意识到自己要去哪儿的那一刻，一种难以言表的强烈自豪感涌了上来。

lines.en: I walk into the maid cafe to applaud her for her newfound impeccable taste only to find that she’s decided to bring along John as well.
lines.zh: 我走进女仆咖啡厅，想为她新养成的绝妙品味鼓掌，却发现她还把 John 也带来了。

lines.en: Now, I don’t have a problem with chickens. I just don’t really think this is the right place for them as they’re unable to grasp the concept of-
lines.zh: 我并不是对鸡有意见。我只是觉得这地方不太适合它们，因为它们没法理解——

lines.en: : Yooooooo why these bitches so cute???
lines.zh: : 哟—————为什么这些小婊砸这么可爱？？？

lines.en: I accept that I will be dining with John as well today and take my place at the table opposite Kaori.
lines.zh: 我接受了今天要和 John 一起吃饭的事实，在 Kaori 对面的位子坐下。

lines.en: I ask her why she thought it was okay to continue coming here without me and she replies with something along the lines of a need to remove clouds.
lines.zh: 我问她为什么觉得可以背着我继续来这里，她的回答大概是要“驱散云朵”之类的。

lines.en: I then ask if she has tried the uniform on again and she informs me that she is saving up money to buy her own, but that she does not want to work here as she can’t “act the way maids do.”
lines.zh: 我又问她有没有再试穿过那套制服，她说她在存钱想买一套自己的，但不想在这里工作，因为她没法“像女仆那样做事”。

lines.en: scene black
To be honest, that’s probably for the best.
lines.zh: 说实话，这样大概是最好的。

lines.en: Kaori should probably avoid taking on any job that hinges on communication skills because...yeah.
lines.zh: Kaori 大概该避开任何依赖沟通技巧的工作，因为……是啊。

lines.en: Frankly, I think it’s miraculous that she’s been able to survive as a waitress for as long as she has. But hey, if it works, it works. And she is very good at her job in terms of everything except the talking part.
lines.zh: 坦白讲，她能当服务员当这么久简直是奇迹。不过话说回来，能干就行。而且除了说话这一部分，她的工作其实做得非常好。

lines.en: Osako, who still works here for some reason, eventually arrives to take our order.
lines.zh: 不知为何还在这里工作的 Osako 终于过来帮我们点单。

lines.en: Kaori asks for two chicken sandwiches. One for herself and one for John.
lines.zh: Kaori 点了两份鸡肉三明治。一份给她自己，一份给 John。

lines.en: It arrives shortly afterward and he partakes in the consumption of his own kind.
lines.zh: 不久之后三明治端了上来，他开始享用起自己的同类。

lines.en: I just get a dessert.
$ kaori_love += 1
{i}Kaori’s affection has increased to [kaori_love]!{/i}
jump saturdaynight
